head.statement: Independent evidence pass over the five P1 items in docs/reviews/full-review-v0.77.0.md and over claim.md/counter.md. No source, spec, test, issue, or docs change; only this file and /tmp were written.

environment.os: Darwin arm64 (macOS); Apple clang; python3 available; GNU-style timeout available
environment.worktree: dirty: M docs/README.md (adds one review-index row only), untracked battle/review-v077-1/, battle/static-dispatch-1/, docs/reviews/full-review-v0.77.0.md. selfhost/, test/, issues/ and docs/spec/ unchanged; HEAD is 5b13fef4. Counts below are from HEAD/worktree as noted.
environment.binary_used: /tmp/rev-ph77-build/ct-ast (built 2026-11-19 20:29; self-reports ct-ast v0.77.0; source paths unchanged since v0.77.0)
environment.prior_full_gate_log: /tmp/ct-full-review-check-all-offline.log exists (from the review session, not produced by this pass): line 2269 'skip: cannot reach ... (curl: (7) Failed to connect ...)', line 3584 '== summary: 1517 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped ==', line 4186 'check-all: OK (11 hard gates green)'.
environment.network: raw.githubusercontent.com was unreachable during this pass (curl timeout). A blackhole address 10.255.255.1 and a deliberately connected-but-stalled local TCP server (127.0.0.1:39417) were used for the timeout tests.
environment.exit_field_semantics: evidence[].exit is the exit code of the tested gate/command (timeout, grep, ls, ct-ast, etc.), not the surrounding shell that appends 'echo rc=$?'. Where a loop is used, the note gives the per-item codes.
limitations: Full selfhost/check-all.sh was not re-run (11-gate suite is long); only g0, g8, battle-selftest, check-docs, selected p72/p75/p77 probes were run. The 11/11 claim is therefore cited from the existing offline log, not independently re-executed.
The real-network green path of p77_external.sh (curl-OK + git-OK) was not reproduced because the index host was unreachable; a stub curl+git fixture was used for the missing-outer-timeout test.
git tag checks are local only; remote tag state was not queried (network unavailable).
Process inspection (ps) was blocked by the file sandbox; elapsed times are wall-clock around the foreground/background command.
This seat did not adjudicate whether a spec whose header says 草稿 is normatively in force; it only records the header text and the project pin.

check-docs was run on the dirty worktree (untracked review report plus its docs/README.md index row), so its 1938-links/323-files count may be one higher than a HEAD-only run; the design-window/status results are unaffected.

Of the 13 listed fixed-but-open entries, 7 have green probes (LANG-3/4/11/16/17/SH-76/LANG-9), PKG-10/11 have fix commits, PKG-9 is a hard error at HEAD, TEST-21 is explicitly pending review, and SH-65/SH-67 are ambiguous (pair form works, single-fp form still hard-errors). No full REV triage of all 24 open issues was performed.

rounds.focus: Read the three positions and establish HEAD/worktree/binary
rounds.result: HEAD 5b13fef4; v0.77.0 tag at 1aff4deb; git status shows only docs/README.md modified plus untracked review/battle files; source selfhost/ct-ast unchanged by HEAD.

rounds.focus: tools/check.sh subcommands and static subprocess code
rounds.result: g0/g8/battle-selftest exist and exit 0; g1..g7 and g9 exit 2. git_run is a bare system(full); no timeout/GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT anywhere in Pkg.h.ct, p77_external.sh, check-ast.sh; check-ast.sh:994 calls the probe with no outer timeout.

Blackhole 12s test killed at 12s (rc=124); same blackhole with 150s cap failed at 75s (OS/git TCP bound) so pure blackhole is not literally infinite. A connected server that accepts and never writes held ct get past 20s and past 90s (rc=124 at both caps), reproducing an unbounded wait with no intrinsic timeout. p77_external.sh without reachable index exits 77 after ~32s (curl 3x10s), so offline is bounded; stub curl+git reproduces p77 hanging past 20s.

rounds.focus: Issue ledger counts and fixed-but-open examples
rounds.result: 221 files, 220 status rows, 1 file with no status row; claim's 220/24/168 reproduced exactly. Counter's 204 is reproducible only as raw-cell exact match plus the missing row; its 'open 25' only as a substring count (lang-5 says '仍 open' in a partly-fixed cell). At least 6 fixed-but-open examples verified; 6 issues put the forbidden word 'fixed' in the status field; only 1/221 has front-matter status.

rounds.focus: phase-ID ledger, blockers, spec draft, doc drift, counts
rounds.result: Ledger and docs/phases absent; blockers file says migration not started; cards lack phase-id/version-minor; master spec and copy both say 草稿 at line 6 while AGENTS pins 1.17.0. Most D items reproduce; D-4's '52 examples' is false (51). test/README 141/119 vs actual 295/299. Phase impact: report 66/142/51 not reproducible; counter 73/138/58 reproducible under stated commands.
No A/B winner declared; per-criterion pass/fail/unresolved recorded in checks.j_matrix.

matrix.topic: ct get / git subprocess intrinsic timeout; p77_external outer timeout; blackhole reproducibility
matrix.note: No intrinsic timeout and no outer timeout are verified. A connected-but-stalled peer reproduces an unbounded wait past 90s; a pure blackhole is bounded by the OS/git TCP timeout (~75s here); an unreachable index makes the probe skip (77) after ~32s. Therefore 'no upper bound' is true; 'offline/blackhole always makes the gate wait forever' is false/conditional. Fixing the outer bound plus a stall/slow-peer negative test is executable.

matrix.topic: Issue count/status words: report 221/24/168 vs counter 221/204
matrix.note: 221 files, 220 status rows, 1 missing row; the report's 221 is a file total while its 24/168 are over the 220 rows, a one-row denominator mismatch. 24 open and 168 outside the 8-word set reproduce exactly under the claim's normalization; 204 reproduces only as raw-cell mismatch plus the missing row, and 25 only as an 'open' substring. G6 would fail anyway: 168 non-closed + 6 forbidden status=fixed + 1 missing = 175 non-compliant rows, and only 1/221 has the front-matter status required by §5.4. At least seven 'fixed but open' entries are real (probes green / fix commits), but open+DEV disposition is the §5.4 intermediate state pending REV, not itself a violation; PKG-9's 'v0.58.2' attribution is wrong (v0.58.2 is PKG-6; HEAD behavior is already a hard error).

No ledger, no docs/phases, no window; blocker file says migration not started and A/B/C await rulings; cards lack phase-id/version-minor. Master spec and project copy both self-label 草稿 at line 6, so the report's '1.17.0 已生效' is not supported by the text even though AGENTS pins it and g0 is green. Report's 66/142/51 counts did not reproduce; counter's 73/138/58 did.
